newsitem.title: USA: U.S Gulf propane edges upward, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S Gulf propane edges upward, trade quiet.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices continued to edge up from a two-day cascade, but players reported extremely thin late trade on Friday.
"I think we just had a heck of a four days this week that many people took a rest this afternoon," said one Midwest trader.
Activity was light this afternoon, compared to the volatility Wednesday and Thursday that was triggered by bearish sentiment over incoming imports and selling by majors.
In late trade, sellers in the U.S. Gulf Coast edged up a quarter cent to 48.50 cents while buyers remained at 48.00 cents a gallon.
Conway, Kansas, hub material rose a half cent to 48.00/48.50 cents in thin talk.
Traders said much support came from recovering NYMEX November crude oil futures, which ended up 40 cents at $24.66 a barrel.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
